items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-12-09
items.q: E-Van jumped up... E-Van jumped behind me and grabbed me away... he was cutting at E-Van.

ctx.x: Uh, they wanted more, they had no money.

And, uh, who started down, he, he goes to his man's house. And, uh, L2, uh, tentatively, having fair with, uh, uh, uh, some of him, uh, Jesus, and my, my, my brother, dad, another legend. Another legend is his brother, a late child. And, uh, they went there to, uh, this boy in the house, asking, uh, to get, you know, whiskey out of the trade. And he told him, no, he wouldn't give it. And, uh, he said, well, the rest of the fella.

What about Ivan coming? He didn't come like he used to come, you know before. He had just got out of the penitentiary. I don't know who said it, I don't know. I don't think Chinese said it because he didn't know it. He was this man. But he would see it, he would later see it, sit down on our porch with the physician. She said, one of the things he said, I'm telling you, the events where your wife was. That boy came up. And some other quarterback told me that, but you know, it was here. And we started, we missed…
